  "memo":"R03 establishes the Card family through the French-issued card, US IP and failed AVS. No other rule holds, no household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Row §6.6(b) initially requires id_check; its failed result now decides under §5.3(b). Recommend decline, with account blocking. Escalation is prohibited because Linkage is absent; clear, hold and needs_check are also prohibited. Legitimate foreign-card use remains a competing explanation, but does not override the failed check. The order has already shipped, so the loss stands. No further check is needed."
